sourceMarkup:
'''Nametags''' ---- '''Nametags''' are tags that appear perpetually floating above the player's head. These display the name of the player, but before the 16th of May 2021, they displayed the player's username. Players can change their '''Nametag''' in the inventory menu. It is possible to disable '''Nametag''' visibility in the settings.
